lessons.text: When a grouping or uniqueness key uses database case folding (lower/upper), test a non-ASCII case pair (SÃO/São) and state the required UTF-8 LC_CTYPE in the spec, because folding depends on the database locale.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when the spec keeps variants distinct but orders them with a comparison that ignores the difference accent insensitive collator name the tie break in the spec so tests do not enforce an unstated choice
lessons.text: When the spec keeps variants distinct but orders them with a comparison that ignores the difference (accent-insensitive collator), name the tie-break in the spec so tests do not enforce an unstated choice.

lessons.key: ac_gap::set the pgjdbc property logservererrordetail false when logs must be pii free unique violation detail echoes the key value into hibernate s warn log
lessons.text: Set the PgJDBC property logServerErrorDetail=false when logs must be PII-free; unique-violation detail echoes the key value into Hibernate's WARN log.

lessons.key: ac_gap::tick application clocks in microseconds when timestamps are stored in postgresql timestamptz or returned values differ from stored ones on linux jdks with nanosecond clocks
lessons.text: Tick application clocks in microseconds when timestamps are stored in PostgreSQL timestamptz, or returned values differ from stored ones on Linux JDKs with nanosecond clocks.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a test for nothing except x is exposed must assert the whole exposed set e g the discovery listing not probe a few sample names
lessons.text: A test for 'nothing except X is exposed' must assert the whole exposed set (e.g. the discovery listing), not probe a few sample names.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::give every check digit branch e g remainder 10 0 its own unit case a data generator that hits it by chance is not evidence
lessons.text: Give every check-digit branch (e.g. remainder 10 -> 0) its own unit case; a data generator that hits it by chance is not evidence.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec promises a per field errors array state whether query parameters and unparseable values are included
lessons.text: When a spec promises a per-field errors array, state whether query parameters and unparseable values are included.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when the author narrows an ac to match current behaviour after verification log it as an unconfirmed assumption for the user never as settled spec
lessons.text: When the author narrows an AC to match current behaviour after verification, log it as an unconfirmed assumption for the user, never as settled spec.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::never put test only settings in a production config location config application properties it shadows production config in every test use a test bean or profile and run mvn clean after deleting resources
lessons.text: Never put test-only settings in a production config location (config/application.properties); it shadows production config in every test. Use a test bean or profile, and run mvn clean after deleting resources.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::assert every contract field of error responses type title detail instance not only status and content type mutants that drop a field survive status only checks
lessons.text: Assert every contract field of error responses (type, title, detail, instance), not only status and content type; mutants that drop a field survive status-only checks.

lessons.key: gate_fail::put archunit violation fixtures outside the application s base package spring component and entity scanning picks up fixture entity component classes and breaks every integration test
lessons.text: Put ArchUnit violation fixtures outside the application's base package; Spring component and entity scanning picks up fixture @Entity/@Component classes and breaks every integration test.
